SML 1 Strategic.dimension_desc: Strategic sovereignty evaluates the corporate governance architecture, ownership dependencies, and long-term continuity planning of the service provider.

objectives.title: Governance Authority (SML 1.CO 1) - Ensuring that individuals and entities with significant governance and decision-making authority are clearly defined and formally designated in order to fulfill their responsibilities.
objectives.sovereignty_contribution: Establishes strategic sovereignty by ensuring that control over service-related decisions is transparent, formally assigned, and free from undisclosed influence, enabling customers to understand who ultimately governs the service.

controls.desc: The entity exercising decisive control (and decision-making authority) over the service is clearly determined regarding roles, bodies and legal entities.
controls.question: Is the entity exercising decisive control and decision-making authority over the service clearly determined?

controls.desc: The entity exercising decisive control (and decision-making authority) over the service assigned all responsible entities and individuals to their services, tasks and made this nformation accessible to stakeholders.
controls.question: Did the entity exercising decisive control and decision-making authority over the service formally assign and inform affected entities, indiviudals and stakeholders about responsibilities for the services?

controls.desc: Details on the nomination, assignment, services and decision-making competencies regarding the related services are formally documented and accessible to all affected individuals and stakeholders.
controls.question: Are the nomination, assignment, services and decision-making competencies regarding the related services formally documented and accessible to all affected individuals and stakeholders?

objectives.title: Ownership and Control Structure (SML 1.CO 2) - Ensure that ownership structures and controlling interests related to the service provider are transparent, identifiable, and do not introduce undisclosed external influence.
objectives.sovereignty_contribution: Strengthens strategic sovereignty by ensuring that ownership and control structures are transparent and that controlling interests can be clearly attributed, reducing the risk of hidden or external influence over the service.

controls.desc: The ownership structure of the service provider is documented and transparent.
controls.question: Is the ownership structure of the service provider documented and transparent?

controls.desc: Ultimate beneficial ownership (UBO) of the service provider is identified and documented.
controls.question: Is the ultimate beneficial ownership (UBO) of the service provider identified, documented, and within a jurisdiction listed in the AJL?

objectives.title: Strategic Alignment with Digital Sovereignty Objectives (SML 1.CO 3) - Ensure that digital sovereignty objectives are explicitly defined and embedded in the strategy and decision-making processes related to the service.
objectives.sovereignty_contribution: Strengthens strategic sovereignty by ensuring that digital sovereignty is an intentional and managed objective, guiding decisions on architecture, providers, and dependencies rather than being incidental.

controls.desc: Digital sovereignty objectives are defined, integrated and updated in the entity's management policies to ensure it is being considered in the implementation of the service or provider strategy on all levels.
controls.question: How is ensured that digital sovereignty objectives are defined, integrated and updated in the entity's management policies and considered in the implementation of the service or provider strategy?

controls.desc: Strategic decisions related to the service consider digital sovereignty objectives.
controls.question: Are digital sovereignty objectives considered in strategic decisions related to the service?

objectives.title: Strategic Independence and Exit Capability (SML 1.CO 4) - Ensure that dependencies on the services are considered at the entity's strategic level and measures are in place to avoid disruptions in case of exits or substitution of the service.
objectives.sovereignty_contribution: Strengthens digital sovereignty by ensuring that dependencies are considered, implications monitored and actively managed to maintain the service quality.

controls.desc: The level of dependencies on external providers relevant to the offered services are defined frequently and updated with regard to their impact on independence and exit capability.
controls.question: How is the process designed to frequently define criteria on and assess the level of dependencies, also considering the exit, of contracted service providers that impact the own offered services?

controls.desc: Measures are in place to continuously detect and monitor how the external service providers' relevant activities impact or disrupt of the own offered services.
controls.question: Are measures in place to continuously detect and monitor the impact of external service providers?

controls.desc: Measures for the substitution or the exit of contracted external providers services are integrated into the decision-making process and design of processes that impact the provided services.
controls.question: How is ensured that the substitution or the exit of contracted external providers services are considered in the decision making and design of processes that impact the own service provided?

objectives.title: Accountability and Strategic Oversight (SML 1.CO 5) - Ensure that accountability for digital sovereignty is clearly assigned and that oversight mechanisms are in place to monitor and enforce related objectives.
objectives.sovereignty_contribution: Strengthens strategic sovereignty by ensuring that digital sovereignty is actively managed, with clear accountability and oversight, rather than remaining an abstract or unowned objective.

controls.desc: Accountability for digital sovereignty is explicitly assigned to defined roles or management functions.
controls.question: Is accountability for digital sovereignty explicitly assigned to defined roles or management functions?

controls.desc: Mechanisms are in place to monitor and oversee digital sovereignty objectives at a strategic level.
controls.question: Are mechanisms in place to monitor and oversee digital sovereignty objectives at a strategic level?

SML 2 Legal and Jurisdictional.dimension_desc: Legal and jurisdictional sovereignty evaluates the legal frameworks, geographic processing boundaries, and regulatory environments governing the services.

objectives.title: Jurisdictional Alignment of Governance and Control (SML 2.CO 1) - Ensure that entities exercising governance, control, and decision-making authority over the service are subject to jurisdictions listed in the Approved Jurisdictions List (AJL).
objectives.sovereignty_contribution: Establishes legal sovereignty by ensuring that decisive governance and control over the service are exercised within trusted jurisdictions, enabling enforceability and reducing exposure to conflicting legal frameworks.

controls.desc: The legal entity exercising decisive governance, control or decision-making authority over the service is incorporated in a jurisdiction listed in the AJL.
controls.question: Is the legal entity exercising decisive governance, control or decision-making authority  over the service incorporated in a jurisdiction listed in the AJL?

controls.desc: All relevant entities that exercise governance, control or decision-making authority over the service are clearly defined and incorporated in a jurisdiction listed in the AJL.
controls.question: Are all relevant entities that exercise governance, control or decision-making authority over the service clearly defined and in a jurisdiction listed in the AJL?

controls.desc: Jurisdictional alignment of governance and control entities is regularly reviewed and documented.
controls.question: Is the jurisdictional alignment of governance and control entities regularly reviewed and documented?

objectives.title: Jurisdiction of Service Delivery and Data Processing (SML 2.CO 2) - Ensure that service delivery, data processing, and operational execution occur within jurisdictions listed in the Approved Jurisdictions List (AJL).
objectives.sovereignty_contribution: Strengthens legal sovereignty by ensuring that service delivery and data processing are performed within trusted jurisdictions, reducing exposure to conflicting legal frameworks.

controls.desc: Contractual agreements ensure that data processing by the service provider is restricted to jurisdictions listed in the AJL.
controls.question: Do contractual agreements ensure that data processing by the service provider is restricted to jurisdictions listed in the AJL?

controls.desc: Contractual agreements ensure that data processing by underlying service providers is restricted to jurisdictions listed in the AJL.
controls.question: Do contractual agreements ensure that data processing by underlying service providers is restricted to jurisdictions listed in the AJL?

controls.desc: Service delivery and operational execution by the service provider are performed within jurisdictions listed in the AJL.
controls.question: Are service delivery and operational execution by the service provider performed within jurisdictions listed in the AJL?

controls.desc: Service delivery and operational execution by underlying service providers are performed within jurisdictions listed in the AJL.
controls.question: Are service delivery and operational execution by underlying service providers performed within jurisdictions listed in the AJL?

controls.desc: Any service delivery or data processing outside jurisdictions listed in the AJL is identified, assessed, and formally approved.
controls.question: Is any service delivery or data processing outside jurisdictions listed in the AJL identified, assessed, and formally approved?

objectives.title: Contractual Transparency and Legal Framework (SML 2.CO 3) - Ensure that contractual agreements clearly define applicable law, jurisdiction, and key rights and obligations related to the service.
objectives.sovereignty_contribution: Strengthens legal sovereignty by ensuring that contractual frameworks are transparent, enforceable, and aligned with trusted jurisdictions.

controls.desc: Contracts clearly define the applicable law governing the service.
controls.question: Do contracts clearly define the applicable law governing the service?

controls.desc: Contracts clearly define the jurisdiction and competent courts for dispute resolution.
controls.question: Do contracts clearly define the jurisdiction and competent courts for dispute resolution?

controls.desc: Contracts clearly define key rights and obligations related to the service, including responsibilities of all involved parties.
controls.question: Do contracts clearly define key rights and obligations related to the service?

objectives.title: Legal Enforceability and Protection of Rights (SML 2.CO 4) - Ensure that rights and obligations related to the service are enforceable and protected within jurisdictions listed in the AJL, including protection against conflicting or extraterritorial legal access.
objectives.sovereignty_contribution: Strengthens legal sovereignty by ensuring that contractual rights can be effectively enforced and that exposure to conflicting legal regimes is minimized.

controls.desc: Contracts ensure that rights and obligations related to the service are enforceable within jurisdictions listed in the AJL.
controls.question: Do contracts ensure that rights and obligations related to the service are legally enforceable within jurisdictions listed in the AJL?

controls.desc: Contracts address and restrict exposure to extraterritorial legal access or conflicting legal obligations.
controls.question: Do contracts address and restrict exposure to extraterritorial legal access or conflicting legal obligations?

controls.desc: Legal risks related to enforceability and conflicting jurisdictions are identified, assessed, and managed.
controls.question: Are legal risks related to enforceability and conflicting jurisdictions identified, assessed, and managed?

controls.desc: Mechanisms and processes are in place to handle legal requests or claims from non-AJL jurisdictions.
controls.question: Are mechanisms and processes in place to handle legal requests or claims from non-AJL jurisdictions?

controls.desc: Technical measures are implemented to support protection against unauthorized or extraterritorial access to the service.
controls.question: Are technical measures implemented to support protection against unauthorized or extraterritorial access to data?

objectives.title: Exposure to Non-AJL Jurisdictions (SML 2.CO 5) - Ensure that exposure to jurisdictions not listed in the AJL is identified, assessed, and appropriately managed.
objectives.sovereignty_contribution: Strengthens legal sovereignty by providing transparency over third-country exposure and ensuring that associated risks are actively managed and mitigated.

controls.desc: Contracts transparently disclose any involvement of jurisdictions not listed in the AJL in the provision of the service.
controls.question: Do contracts transparently disclose any involvement of jurisdictions not listed in the AJL in the provision of the service?

controls.desc: Contracts define safeguards and conditions for the involvement of jurisdictions not listed in the AJL.
controls.question: Do contracts define safeguards and conditions for the involvement of jurisdictions not listed in the AJL?

SML 3 Data.dimension_desc: Data sovereignty measures the control parameters established over data assets throughout their lifecycle.

objectives.title: Access Control (SML 3.CO 1) - Ensure customers retain control over access to their data.
objectives.sovereignty_contribution: Ensures that customers can independently define and enforce access to their data without reliance on the provider. Prevents unauthorized and privileged provider access and enables full control through technical enforcement mechanisms, including customer-controlled cryptographic keys.

controls.desc: Contracts ensure that the customer retains sole authority to define, grant, modify, and revoke access rights to their data.
controls.question: Does the contract explicitly grant the customer sole authority to define, grant, modify, and revoke access to their data?

controls.desc: Policies and procedures ensure that access to customer data is restricted to authorized entities and is not performed without explicit customer authorization.
controls.question: Are policies and procedures in place to ensure that access to customer data is restricted and only performed with explicit customer authorization?

controls.desc: Customers use role-based and/or attribute-based access control models to define, assign, and enforce access rights to their data.
controls.question: Can customers independently define and enforce access rights to their data using role-based or attribute-based access control mechanisms?

controls.desc: Access to customer data is technically protected through cryptographic mechanisms, and that such access cannot be performed without use of the corresponding cryptographic keys.
controls.question: Is access to customer data technically enforced through encryption mechanisms that prevent access without the corresponding cryptographic keys?

controls.desc: Customers can independently obtain, manage, and control cryptographic keys.
controls.service_type: PaaS, SaaS, AI Service, Managed Service
controls.question: Can customers independently manage, rotate, and control cryptographic keys associated with their data?

controls.desc: The underlying services support customer-controlled key management and access control capabilities required to enforce customer-defined access restrictions.
controls.question: Do the underlying services support customer-controlled key management and access control capabilities required to enforce customer-defined access restrictions?

objectives.title: Portability (SML 3.CO 2) - Ensure customers are able to access, retrieve, and export their data in a usable and portable manner.
objectives.sovereignty_contribution: Ensures that customers can retrieve and transfer their data without dependency on the provider, enabling effective data portability and preventing vendor lock-in.

controls.desc: Contract ensures that the customer can access, retrieve and export their data at any time without undue restriction or delay.
controls.question: Does the contract ensure that the customer can access, retrieve, and export their data at any time without undue restrictions or delays?

controls.desc: Processes exist that callow customers to retrieve and export data including all relevant datasets required for continued use.
controls.question: Are there defined and implemented processes ensuring that customer data can be retrieved and exported in a complete and consistent manner?

controls.desc: The service provides mechanisms that allow customers to access and retrieve their data independently via user interfaces and/or APIs.
controls.question: Can customers retrieve and/or export their data via a defined process?

controls.desc: Backup systems and data duplication locations are restricted to jurisdictions listed in the AJL.
controls.question: Are Backup Systems and data duplication locations restricted to jurisdictions listed in the AJL?

controls.desc: Ensuring complete and correct data export to enable effective reuse of the data.
controls.question: Can it be verified that the data was transferred completely and correctly?

controls.desc: The underlying services support data extraction and transfer capabilities required to enable customer-driven data portability.
controls.question: Do the underlying services support data extraction and transfer capabilities required to enable customer-driven data portability?

objectives.title: Usage Control (SML 3.CO 3) - Ensure customer data is only processed and used for purposes explicitly defined and authorized by the customer.
objectives.sovereignty_contribution: Ensures that customer data is not used beyond customer-defined purposes, preventing unauthorized processing and maintaining full control over how data is utilized.

controls.desc: Contract ensures that customer data is only processed and used for purposes explicitly defined and authorized by the customer.
controls.question: Does the contract explicitly restrict the processing and use of customer data to purposes defined and authorized by the customer?

controls.desc: The provider implements and enforces policies and procedures ensuring that customer data is not accessed or processed for purposes beyond those authorized by the customer.
controls.question: Are there enforced policies and procedures ensuring that customer data is not processed or used beyond authorized purposes?

controls.desc: The service ensures that data processing activities are limited to configured and authorized purposes and cannot be executed outside of these defined constraints.
controls.question: Does the service ensure that data processing activities are restricted to configured and authorized purposes?

objectives.title: Integrity (SML 3.CO 4) - Ensure customer data is protected against unauthorized modification or deletion.
objectives.sovereignty_contribution: Ensures that customer data cannot be altered or deleted without authorization, preserving data integrity and preventing unauthorized or provider-driven modifications.

controls.desc: The contract ensures that customer data cannot be modified or deleted without authorization defined by the customer.
controls.question: Does the contract explicitly ensure that customer data cannot be modified or deleted without customer-defined authorization?

controls.desc: Policies and procedures exist ensuring that all modifications and deletions of customer data are authorized, traceable and controlled.
controls.question: Are there enforced policies and procedures ensuring that all data modification and deletion activities are authorized, controlled, and traceable?

controls.desc: The service ensures that all data modification and deletion actions are logged and regularly reviewed.
controls.question: Are all changes to and deletions of data logged and regularly monitored?

controls.desc: The service provides mechanisms to protect data integrity, including versioning, immutability, or recovery capabilities to prevent or mitigate unauthorized changes or deletions.
controls.question: Does the service provide mechanisms such as versioning, immutability, or recovery capabilities to prevent or mitigate unauthorized data changes or deletions?

controls.desc: The underlying service supports mechanisms for ensure data integrity and preventing unauthorized modification or deletion.
controls.question: Do the underlying services support mechanisms to ensure data integrity and prevent unauthorized modification or deletion?

SML 4 Operational.dimension_desc: Operational sovereignty evaluates the capacity to run, maintain, and support services independently of external or unilateral provider controls.

objectives.title: Operational Control (SML 4.CO 1) - Ensure operational control over the service is defined, transparent, and not solely dependent on the provider.
objectives.sovereignty_contribution: Ensures that operational control of the service is not exclusively held by the provider, enabling customers to retain influence over service operation and reducing operational dependency.

controls.desc: Contracts define operational roles and responsibilities, including allocation of control between provider and customer.
controls.question: Does the contract clearly define operational roles, responsibilities, and the allocation of control between provider and customer?

controls.desc: Documented operational governance structures are implemented and maintained to clearly define responsibilities and control over service operation.
controls.question: Are there documented governance structures defining operational responsibilities and control over service operation?

controls.desc: The service provides customers with visibility and control over operational aspects relevant to their service usage.
controls.question: Can customers monitor and influence operational aspects of the service relevant to their usage?

controls.desc: Critical operational actions cannot be executed solely by the provider without defined customer involvement or control where applicable.
controls.question: Are critical operational actions restricted such that they cannot be executed solely by the provider without defined customer involvement or control?

controls.desc: The underlying services support operational control capabilities that enable separation of responsibilities and reduce dependency on a single provider for service operation.
controls.question: Do the underlying services support capabilities that enable separation of operational responsibilities and reduce dependency on a single provider?

objectives.title: Administrative Access (SML 4.CO 2) - Ensure administrative access to the service is controlled and not exclusively held by the provider.
objectives.sovereignty_contribution: Ensures that administrative control over the service is not exclusively held by the provider, enabling customers to manage or influence privileged access and reducing dependency on provider-controlled administration.

controls.desc: Contracts define administrative roles, responsibilities, and privileged access, including allocation between provider and customer.
controls.question: Does the contract clearly define administrative roles, responsibilities, and the allocation of privileged access between provider and customer?

controls.desc: Policies and procedures are implemented and enforced to ensure administrative access is restricted, controlled, and assigned according to defined roles and responsibilities.
controls.question: Are there enforced policies and procedures ensuring that administrative access is restricted and assigned based on defined roles and responsibilities?

controls.desc: The service enables customers to manage and control administrative access rights where applicable.
controls.question: Can customers manage and control administrative access rights where applicable?

controls.desc: Critical administrative actions cannot be executed solely by the provider without customer involvement, approval, or separation of duties.
controls.question: Are administrative actions restricted such that they cannot be executed solely by the provider without appropriate controls (e.g., customer approval or separation of duties)?

controls.desc: Underlying services provide role-based administrative access control and separation of privileged access.
controls.question: Do the underlying services support role-based administrative access control and separation of privileged access?

objectives.title: Service Operations (SML 4.CO 3) - Ensure service operations are defined, controlled, and do not create unmanaged dependency on the provider.
objectives.sovereignty_contribution: Ensures that day-to-day service operations are not solely controlled by the provider, enabling customers to retain influence over operational processes and reducing operational dependency.

controls.desc: Contracts define the scope, responsibilities, and allocation of day-to-day service operations between provider and customer.
controls.question: Does the contract clearly define the scope, responsibilities, and allocation of day-to-day service operations between provider and customer?

controls.desc: Documented operational procedures are implemented and maintained to govern the execution of day-to-day service operations.
controls.question: Are documented operational procedures in place governing the execution of day-to-day service operations?

controls.desc: The service enables customers to monitor the operational status and execution of service operations relevant to their usage.
controls.question: Can customers monitor the operational status and execution of service operations relevant to their usage?

controls.desc: Operational activities are executed according to defined procedures and cannot be performed in an uncontrolled or discretionary manner by the provider.
controls.question: Are service operations executed based on defined procedures and not subject to uncontrolled or discretionary execution by the provider?

objectives.title: Incident and Recovery (SML 4.CO 4) - Ensure incident response, recovery, and service continuity are defined, controlled, and not solely dependent on the provider.
objectives.sovereignty_contribution: Ensures that incident response and recovery are not exclusively controlled by the provider, enabling customers to retain influence over service restoration and continuity.

controls.desc: Contracts define incident response, recovery, and service continuity responsibilities, including allocation of roles between provider and customer.
controls.question: Does the contract clearly define incident response, recovery, and service continuity responsibilities, including the allocation of roles between provider and customer?

controls.desc: Documented processes are implemented and maintained for incident response, recovery, and service continuity.
controls.question: Are documented processes in place governing incident response, recovery, and service continuity?

controls.desc: The service enables customers to monitor incidents and the status of recovery and continuity measures affecting their service usage.
controls.question: Can customers monitor incidents and the status of recovery and continuity measures affecting their service usage?

controls.desc: Recovery and service restoration activities are executed according to defined procedures and cannot rely solely on provider discretion.
controls.question: Are recovery and service restoration activities executed based on defined procedures and not solely dependent on provider discretion?

controls.desc: The service enables customers to influence or initiate recovery and data restoration processes where applicable.
controls.question: Can customers influence or initiate recovery and data restoration processes where applicable?

controls.desc: Underlying services provide backup, recovery, and failover capabilities to enable independent and controlled restoration of services and data.
controls.question: Do the underlying services provide backup, recovery, and failover capabilities that enable controlled and independent restoration of services and data?

objectives.title: Change and Service Evolution (SML 4.CO 5) - Ensure changes to the service are defined, controlled, and cannot be unilaterally executed by the provider.
objectives.sovereignty_contribution: Ensures that service changes are not exclusively controlled by the provider, enabling customers to retain influence over service evolution and preventing unilateral changes that impact service usage.

controls.desc: Contracts define change management responsibilities, including the roles of provider and customer in approving and implementing service changes.
controls.question: Does the contract clearly define change management responsibilities, including the roles of provider and customer in approving and implementing service changes?

controls.desc: Documented change management processes are implemented and maintained to govern planning, approval, and implementation of service changes.
controls.question: Are documented change management processes in place governing the planning, approval, and implementation of service changes?

controls.desc: The service enables customers to be informed about, and where applicable approve or configure, service changes affecting their usage.
controls.question: Are customers informed about service changes and able to approve or configure changes that impact their usage where applicable?

controls.desc: Changes affecting customer-relevant functionality or service behavior cannot be executed unilaterally by the provider without defined control mechanisms.
controls.question: Are changes affecting customer-relevant functionality or service behavior prevented from being executed unilaterally by the provider without defined control mechanisms?

SML 5 Supply Chain.dimension_desc: Supply chain sovereignty measures the geographic composition, component tracking, and systemic resilience of the third-party ecosystem supporting the service.

objectives.title: Transparency (SML 5.CO 1) - Ensure dependencies on third-party providers are identified and transparent.

controls.desc: Contracts with third-party providers disclose their involvement, roles, and responsibilities in delivering the service.

controls.question: Are customers provided with visibility into third-party dependencies that impact their service usage?

objectives.title: Supplier Governance (SML 5.CO 2) - Ensure third-party providers are governed and controlled to prevent unmanaged dependency.
objectives.sovereignty_contribution: Ensures that third-party providers are subject to defined governance and control mechanisms, reducing dependency risks and preventing uncontrolled external influence on the service.

controls.question: Are measures implemented and maintained to manage and mitigate risks associated with critical dependencies?

objectives.title: Substitution and Exit (SML 5.CO 4) - Ensure dependencies can be substituted or exited without excessive disruption.

objectives.title: Requirement flow-down (SML 5.CO 5) - Ensure digital sovereignty and control requirements are enforced across the supply chain.
objectives.sovereignty_contribution: Ensures that sovereignty and control requirements are consistently enforced across all third-party providers, preventing gaps and reducing risk from weak links in the supply chain.

controls.desc: Contracts with third-party providers require compliance with defined digital sovereignty and control requirements.
controls.question: Do contracts with third-party providers ensure that sovereignty and control requirements are imposed on them?

controls.desc: Processes are implemented and maintained to verify that third-party providers comply with defined digital sovereignty and control requirements.
controls.question: Are processes in place to verify that third-party providers comply with defined sovereignty and control requirements?

controls.desc: Non-compliance by third-party providers is identified, managed, and remediated through defined processes.
controls.question: Is non-compliance of third-party providers identified, managed, and remediated in a controlled manner?

SML 6 Technology.dimension_desc: Technology sovereignty assesses the openness, auditability, and physical or logical layout of the underlying technical stack.

objectives.title: Infrastructure Location and Control (SML 6.CO 1) - Ensure the physical and virtual infrastructure is located and controlled within approved jurisdictions.
objectives.sovereignty_contribution: Ensures that the infrastructure underpinning the service is located and controlled within approved jurisdictions, preventing exposure to non-approved legal environments and reducing sovereignty risks.

controls.desc: Contracts are in place to ensure that all infrastructure used to deliver the service is located within jurisdictions listed in the AJL.
controls.question: Does the contract ensure that all infrastructure used to deliver the service is located within approved jurisdictions?

controls.desc: Documented policies exist governing the selection and use of infrastructure locations, ensuring alignment with jurisdictions listed in the AJL.
controls.question: Are policies in place governing the selection and use of infrastructure locations to ensure alignment with approved jurisdictions?

controls.desc: All infrastructure components, including primary, backup, failover, and replication environments, are located within jurisdictions listed in the AJL.
controls.question: Are all infrastructure components, including primary, backup, failover, and replication environments, located within approved jurisdictions?

controls.desc: Transfers or processing of workloads to/ via infrastructure not located within approved jurisdictions are prevented, including during failover or scaling scenarios.

objectives.title: Portability and Interoperability (SML 6.CO 3) - Ensure the service can be ported and integrated across different technical environments.
objectives.sovereignty_contribution: Ensures that the service can be migrated and integrated across different environments, reducing technical barriers and enabling flexibility and independence.

objectives.title: Technology Control and Transparency (SML 6.CO 4) - Ensure the technology stack is transparent and under defined control.

controls.desc: Governance processes exist for approving, managing, and controlling changes to the technology stack.
controls.question: Are governance processes in place for approving, managing, and controlling changes to the technology stack?

controls.desc: All components used in the technology stack are disclosed, managed, and controlled to prevent hidden dependencies or risks.
controls.question: Are mechanisms in place to ensure that no undisclosed or unmanaged components are used within the technology stack?

SML 7 Security and Compliance.dimension_desc: Security and compliance sovereignty evaluates the isolation, administrative control, and auditability of security configurations and compliance mechanisms.

objectives.title: Identity and Access (SML 7.CO 1) - Ensure access to the service is protected and controlled to prevent unauthorized use.
objectives.sovereignty_contribution: Ensures that access to the service is securely controlled and not solely dependent on the provider, enabling customers to retain control over identities and access permissions.

controls.desc: Policies for identity and access, including authentication, authorization, and access control, are formally defined and documented.
controls.question: Are policies defined and maintained for identity and access management, including authentication, authorization, and access control principles?

controls.desc: Privileged access is restricted, documented, monitored, and managed according to defined controls.
controls.question: Is access to privileged accounts limited, documented, and regularly monitored for compliance with defined controls?

controls.desc: Strong authentication mechanisms, including multi-factor authentication for privileged or sensitive access, are enforced for all user accounts.
controls.question: Are strong authentication mechanisms enforced in accordance with defined policies, including multi-factor authentication for privileged or sensitive access?

controls.desc: Access is controlled using role-based or attribute-based mechanisms, ensuring users only have access according to their defined roles and responsibilities.
controls.question: Is there a formal concept or policy for role-based or attribute-based access controls that ensures users have access only according to their defined roles and responsibilities?

controls.desc: Segregation of access between customer and provider is enforced, preventing unauthorized or undisclosed privileged access by the provider.
controls.question: How is access between customer and provider controlled to prevent unrestricted or undisclosed privileged access by the provider?

controls.desc: Identity and access control mechanisms, including identity federation and integration with external identity providers, are supported and enforced for all users.
controls.question: How are identity and access control mechanisms implemented in the underlying services, including identity federation and integration with external identity providers?

objectives.title: Protection (SML 7.CO 2) - The service shall implement technical controls that ensure the confidentiality and integrity of data throughout its lifecycle, including encryption in transit and at rest.
objectives.sovereignty_contribution: Ensures that the service is protected against unauthorized access and misuse, reducing the risk of external compromise and uncontrolled internal access.

controls.desc: A documented policy exists to protect the service against unauthorized access, misuse, and data compromise throughout its lifecycle.
controls.question: Are policies defined and maintained to protect the service against unauthorized access and misuse?

controls.desc: Mechanisms exist to ensure that access and interactions are restricted to authorized entities, preventing unauthorized internal or external use of the service and its data.
controls.question: Are technical protection mechanisms implemented to prevent unauthorized access, including network and interface protection?

controls.desc: Technical protection mechanisms exist to prevent unauthorized access to the service, including network, interface, and system-level protections.
controls.question: Do mechanisms exist to restrict access to authorized entities, and how are they implemented?

controls.desc: Mechanisms exist to ensure the confidentiality and integrity of data throughout its lifecycle, including encryption in transit and at rest and measures to prevent unauthorized modification.
controls.question: Do mechanisms exist to ensure the confidentiality and integrity of data throughout its lifecycle, including encryption in transit and at rest, and how are these mechanisms implemented?

objectives.title: Security Visibility and Control (SML 7.CO 4) - Ensure customers have visibility into and control over security mechanisms relevant to their service.
objectives.sovereignty_contribution: Ensures that customers are not dependent on the provider’s internal security operations by providing visibility and control over relevant security mechanisms.

controls.desc: Documented policies are in place for providing customers with visibility into and control over security mechanisms, and mechanisms are in place to enforce the implementation of these policies.
controls.question: Are policies defined and maintained to provide customers with visibility into and control over security mechanisms?

controls.desc: Customers are provided with role-based access to view security configurations and settings relevant to their service usage.
controls.question: Are mechanisms in place to provide customers with role-based access to view security configurations and mechanisms relevant to their service usage?

controls.desc: Authorized customer users can configure and manage security settings within their scope of responsibility through defined interfaces.
controls.question: Are mechanisms in place that enable authorized customer users to configure and manage security settings within their defined scope of responsibility through defined interfaces?

controls.desc: Customers have visibility into security-relevant configurations and their impact on the service, including logging of configuration changes.
controls.question: Are mechanisms in place to provide customers with visibility into security-relevant configurations and their impact on the service, including logging of configuration changes?

controls.desc: Underlying services allow configuration and management of security controls, ensuring that configurations are valid and secure.
controls.question: Do the underlying services provide mechanisms to configure and manage security controls relevant to the service, ensuring configurations are valid and secure?

objectives.title: Sensitive Operations (SML 7.CO 5) - Ensure sensitive operations are protected against misuse or unauthorized execution.
objectives.sovereignty_contribution: Ensures that critical operations cannot be executed without appropriate protection, reducing the risk of misuse and strengthening customer control over high-impact actions.

controls.desc: Documented policies are in place for protecting sensitive operations against misuse or unauthorized execution, and mechanisms are in place to enforce these policies.
controls.question: Are policies defined and maintained to protect sensitive operations against misuse or unauthorized execution?

controls.desc: Additional safeguards for sensitive operations, such as multi-step approval, strong authentication, or confirmation mechanisms, are implemented and enforced.
controls.question: Are additional safeguards enforced for sensitive operations, such as multi-step approval, strong authentication, or confirmation mechanisms?

controls.desc: Execution of sensitive operations is restricted to authorized roles with clearly defined permissions.
controls.question: Are sensitive operations restricted to authorized roles with clearly defined permissions?

controls.desc: Mechanisms are in place to log and ensure traceability of sensitive operations.
controls.question: Are sensitive operations traceable and logged?

controls.desc: Underlying services protect and control the execution of sensitive operations, enforcing defined security requirements.
controls.question: Do the underlying services support mechanisms to protect and control the execution of sensitive operations, including enforcement of defined security requirements?

SML 8 Environmental.dimension_desc: Environmental sustainability evaluates the long-term operational resilience, resource dependency profiles, and metric transparency of the service regarding environmental constraints.

objectives.title: Energy Autonomy (SML 8.CO 1) - Ensure that the service is operated with controlled and resilient energy dependencies that do not introduce critical risks to long-term operation.
objectives.sovereignty_contribution: Reduces reliance on unstable or externally controlled energy sources, ensuring continuous and sovereign service operation.

controls.desc: Underlying service providers have contractually defined and governed energy supply arrangements and dependencies.
controls.question: Do underlying service providers have contractually defined and governed energy supply arrangements and dependencies?

controls.desc: The service provider has defined policies and processes to identify, assess, and monitor dependencies on energy supply relevant to the service.
controls.question: Has the service provider defined policies and processes to identify, assess, and monitor dependencies on energy supply?

objectives.title: Resource Dependencies (SML 8.CO 2) - Ensure that dependencies on critical resources (e.g., hardware, cooling, materials) are identified, controlled, and do not create structural risks.
objectives.sovereignty_contribution: Limits exposure to resource scarcity and external supply dependencies that could affect service continuity and sovereignty.

controls.desc: Underlying service providers have contractually defined and governed dependencies on critical resources required for service operation.
controls.question: Do underlying service providers have contractually defined and governed dependencies on critical resources required for service operation?

controls.desc: The service provider has defined policies and processes to identify, assess, and monitor dependencies on critical resources relevant to the service.
controls.question: Has the service provider defined policies and processes to identify, assess, and monitor dependencies on critical resources?

objectives.title: Environmental Risk Exposure (SML 8.CO 3) - Ensure that environmental risk exposure affecting service operation is understood and considered in the design and operation of the service.
objectives.sovereignty_contribution: Reduces structural risks from environmental conditions that could impact long-term control and operability.

controls.desc: Underlying service providers identify and assess environmental risk exposure relevant to service operation.
controls.question: Do underlying service providers identify and assess environmental risk exposure relevant to service operation?

controls.desc: The service provider assesses and considers environmental risk exposure when designing or operating the service.
controls.question: Does the service provider assess and consider environmental risk exposure of underlying services when designing or operating the service?

objectives.title: Dependency Transparency (SML 8.CO 4) - Ensure transparency regarding energy usage, resource dependencies, and environmental constraints relevant to the service.
objectives.sovereignty_contribution: Enables customers to understand and manage environmental dependencies impacting sovereignty.

controls.desc: Underlying service providers provide transparency on environmental dependencies and constraints relevant to service operation.
controls.question: Do underlying service providers provide transparency on environmental dependencies and constraints relevant to service operation?

controls.desc: The service provider ensures that relevant environmental dependencies of underlying services are known and documented.
controls.question: Does the service provider ensure that relevant environmental dependencies of underlying services are known and documented?

objectives.title: Long-term Operational Sustainability (SML 8.CO 5) - Ensure that the service is designed and operated to remain stable and operable over time despite environmental and resource constraints.
objectives.sovereignty_contribution: Supports sustained sovereignty by ensuring long-term availability and independence of the service.

controls.desc: Underlying service providers consider long-term environmental and resource-related constraints in their operational planning.
controls.question: Do underlying service providers consider long-term environmental and resource-related constraints in their operational planning?

controls.desc: The service provider considers long-term environmental and resource-related constraints when selecting and using underlying services.
controls.question: Does the service provider consider long-term environmental and resource-related constraints when selecting and using underlying services?

SML 9 AI.dimension_desc: AI sovereignty evaluates the organizational oversight, system clarity, and independent control of artificial intelligence solutions.

objectives.title: AI Governance (SML 9.CO 1) - Ensure that governance structures are established to define responsibility, oversight, and accountability for the development, deployment, and operation of AI systems.
objectives.sovereignty_contribution: Ensures that AI systems are subject to organizational oversight and not operated without clear responsibility or control.

controls.desc: The service provider has defined and documented governance structures for the development, deployment, and operation of AI systems.
controls.question: Has the service provider defined and documented governance structures for development, deployment, and operation of AI systems?

controls.desc: The service ensures that AI-driven decisions can be controlled, restricted, or overridden where necessary.
controls.question: Does the service ensure that AI-driven decisions can be controlled, restricted, or overridden where necessary?

controls.desc: The use of AI within the service can be configured or limited by the customer or operator.
controls.question: Can the use of AI within the service be configured or limited by the customer or operator?

objectives.title: AI Transparency (SML 9.CO 2) - The provider shall ensure that the architecture, capabilities, limitations, and intended use of AI models are documented and communicated to relevant stakeholders.
objectives.sovereignty_contribution: Enables customers and regulators to understand how AI systems operate and prevents opaque “black box” dependencies.

controls.desc: The architecture, key components, capabilities, limitations, and intended use of AI models are defined and documented.
controls.question: Are architecture, key components, capabilities, limitations, and intended use of AI models defined and documented?

controls.desc: AI documentation is made available to relevant stakeholders and customers in accordance with governance policies and legal requirements.
controls.question: Is documentation about AI systems available to relevant stakeholders?

objectives.title: Explainability (SML 9.CO 3) - Ensure AI systems are designed in a way that allows meaningful explanation of decision-making processes and enables human oversight or intervention where necessary.
objectives.sovereignty_contribution: Ensures that organizations remain in control of automated decision-making processes rather than delegating authority entirely to AI systems.

controls.desc: The service provides mechanisms to review AI-generated outputs or decisions before or after execution where relevant.
controls.question: Does the service provide mechanisms to review AI-generated outputs or decisions where relevant?

controls.desc: AI systems are designed to incorporate explainability mechanisms tailored to the underlying model type.
controls.question: Are AI systems designed to incorporate explainability mechanisms tailored to the underlying model type, including providing appropriate metrics and documentation?

controls.desc: Human oversight mechanisms are defined for critical AI-driven decisions.
controls.question: Does the service enable human intervention to override, correct, or stop AI-driven actions?

controls.desc: Policies and procedures define when and how human oversight is required for AI-driven decisions.
controls.question: Are policies and procedures defined specifying when and how human oversight is required for AI-driven decisions?

objectives.title: External AI Dependencies (SML 9.CO 4) - Ensure that dependencies on external AI services are transparent, controlled, and do not lead to loss of control over AI functionality.
objectives.sovereignty_contribution: Prevents lock-in and loss of control by ensuring that reliance on external AI providers does not undermine autonomy or operational independence.

controls.desc: The service clearly identifies and documents dependencies on external AI services used within its functionality.
controls.question: Are dependencies on external AI services used within the service identified and documented?

controls.desc: The service is designed to control or limit the use of external AI services where necessary.
controls.question: Is the service designed to control or limit the use of external AI services where necessary?

controls.desc: Alternative solutions or fallback options are defined for critical dependencies on external AI services.
controls.question: Are alternative solutions or fallback options defined for critical dependencies on external AI services?

objectives.title: AI Lifecycle Management (SML 9.CO 5) - The organization shall manage the lifecycle of AI models, including training, validation, deployment, monitoring, retraining, and retirement.
objectives.sovereignty_contribution: Prevents uncontrolled model drift and ensures long-term accountability for AI behavior.

controls.desc: The lifecycle of AI models is documented, including training, validation, deployment, monitoring, retirement and complete model lineage information.
controls.question: Is the lifecycle of AI models documented and regularly reviewed?

controls.desc: AI models and changes are validated before deployment. Validation data is documentated and updated regularly.
controls.question: Are AI models validated before deployment and validation procedures and results documented?

controls.desc: AI model performance is regularly monitored after deployment.
controls.question: Are monitoring metrics defined and AI model performance monitored after deployment?

controls.desc: Processes exist for retraining or updating models when necessary.
controls.question: Are processes defined for retraining or updating AI models?

objectives.title: Control over AI Assets (SML 9.CO 6) - Ensure that AI model artifacts, including weights and architecture, remain under the control of the service operator and are protected from unauthorized access or modification by the infrastructure provider.
objectives.sovereignty_contribution: Preserves AI sovereignty by preventing infrastructure providers from accessing or modifying model artifacts during execution.

controls.desc: The service ensures that AI model artifacts (e.g., model weights, configurations) remain under the control of the service provider.
controls.question: Are AI model artifacts, including model weights, configurations, and architecture, documented and controlled by the service operator and protected from unauthorized access?

controls.desc: Access to AI model artifacts is restricted and controlled to prevent unauthorized access or modification.
controls.question: Is access to AI model artifacts restricted and controlled, including documented and enforced access permissions?

controls.desc: The service provider defines policies and processes to maintain control over AI model artifacts.
controls.question: Are  policies and processes defined and implemented to maintain control over AI model artifacts?

objectives.title: External Access to Traning Data (SML 9.CO 7) - Ensure that dependencies on external AI providers do not allow access to training data, which must remain confidential and protected from disclosure, storage, or reuse by the external provider.
objectives.sovereignty_contribution: Preserves AI data sovereignty by preventing external AI providers from accessing or retaining training data during processing.

controls.desc: Safeguards are defined and implemented to prevent disclosure or retention of training data.
controls.question: Are safeguards defined and implemented to prevent disclosure or retention of training data?

controls.desc: Contracts with external AI providers define restrictions on the use of customer data as training data.
controls.question: Do contracts with external AI providers restrict the use of training data?

controls.desc: Technical mechanisms prevent external AI providers from storing or reusing training data.
controls.question: Are technical mechanisms implemented to prevent storage or reuse of training data by external providers?

objectives.title: Training Data (SML 9.CO 8) - Organizations shall maintain transparency and governance over the sources, ownership, and legal status of training data used for AI models.
objectives.sovereignty_contribution: Prevents hidden legal, ethical, or jurisdictional risks related to training datasets.

controls.desc: Sources of training data used for AI models are documented.
controls.question: Are sources of AI training data documented, versioned, and periodically reviewed?

controls.desc: Ownership and legal rights associated with training data for AI models are assessed and documented.
controls.question: Are ownership and legal rights associated with training data for AI models assessed and documented?
